name: ABEMA
author: polidog
description: What every ABEMA channel is airing right now, in one panel. Open a channel for its own listing, or click a programme to watch it.

barWidget.description: Live ABEMA schedule; click a programme to watch it, or a channel for its listing.

schema.label: Panel layout
schema.description: grid is abema.tv/timetable’s shape — a column per channel, time running down. listing is a newspaper TV column, grouped by start time.

schema.label: Open a channel with
schema.description: webapp opens a dedicated player window; browser opens a tab in the default browser.
